425:t_3:95.en:
$$刹那$$
「It looks like there's no point trying to stop you.」

425:t_3:96.en:
$n
「I might cause trouble for you guys too. But...」

425:t_3:98.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Besides, Miss $$スズネ$$ isn't just your concern, $n.」

425:t_3:99.en:
$$シモン$$
「That's right. Don't worry about anything else. Give it everything you've got.」

425:t_3:102.en:
$$アルト$$
「That's not it. Miss $$スズネ$$ taught you what to say at a time like this, didn't she?」

425:t_3:104.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now that you've sold your soul to the devil, $n, I'll tell you one more thing about $$ジェニオン$$.」

425:t_3:105.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$ＤＥＭ$$, the name of $$ジェニオン$$'s machine category, stands for Dimension Energy Machinery, but also...」

425:t_3:107.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Diabolus Ex Machina... A devil from the machine, huh?」

425:t_3:108.en:
$$桂$$
「That's in terrible taste, through and through.」

425:t_3:109.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$n... Please use that power to turn everything around.」

425:t_3:110.en:
$n
「I will... I'll rescue Miss $$スズネ$$ and $$セツコ$$, no matter what.」

425:t_3:112.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Even if you can draw out your $$スフィア$$'s power, it looks like you can't celebrate under these circumstances.」

425:t_3:113.en:
$$青山$$
「Are you talking about $$セツコ$$ and $$バルビエル$$?」

425:t_3:114.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Of course, they worry me too, but I just can't get past $$アドヴェント#pilot$$...」

425:t_3:115.en:
$$デュオ$$
「You guys fought alongside him, right? Why bring this up now?」

425:t_3:116.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Sure, he's suspicious in some ways, but at least he isn't our enemy, right?」

425:t_3:117.en:
$$クロウ$$
「My instincts tell me that too.」

425:t_3:118.en:
$$ランド$$
「We had the same discussion when we fought alongside him, and that's the conclusion we reached.」

425:t_3:119.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Hey... Do you know the saying 'love is blind'?」

425:t_3:120.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Why bring that up all of a sudden...?」

425:t_3:121.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Maybe we're relying too much on our instincts and emotions to think clearly...」

425:t_3:122.en:
???
「...I'd expect no less from the $$揺れる天秤$$' Reactor. You stick to your own convictions.」

425:t_3:124.en:
$$トライア$$
「What a greeting for our long-awaited reunion.」

425:t_3:125.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$トライア・スコート$$... I've just arrived on the $$翠の地球$$.」

425:t_10:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「...Everyone, you're ready for this, right?」

425:t_10:5.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「We'll get Miss $$スズネ$$ back ourselves, no matter what!」

425:t_10:7.en:
$$カレン$$
「Look ahead, $$シンジ$$. $n has made up his mind too.」

425:t_10:8.en:
$$甲児$$
「We're going to do this too.」

425:t_10:9.en:
$$アマタ$$
「We'll back up $n and stop Miss $$スズネ$$.」

425:t_10:10.en:
$$宗介$$
「No one ordered us to do this. It's our own decision... In other words, we're volunteers.」

425:t_10:11.en:
$$竜馬$$
「All right, Volunteer Club. We finally get to do something besides picking up trash.」

425:t_10:13.en:
$$アルト$$
「From the Volunteer Club President to all members: our mission is to help $n and get Miss $$スズネ$$ back.」

425:t_10:14.en:
$$アルト$$
「Let's do this! We're going to make this mission a success, no matter what!」

425:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Splendid, everyone. It seems you've found your resolve while fighting Miss $$スズネ$$.)

425:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(That strong will has produced 100Z in $$Ｚチップ$$s. I'll add them to the unit's stock.)

425:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(If I came out now, I'd only dampen everyone's spirits. I'll wish you success from here.)

425:t_10:23.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't put too much pressure on yourself, $$シン$$.」

425:t_10:24.en:
$$シン$$
「...I know. But I'm going to rescue $$セツコ$$, no matter what.」

425:t_10:25.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「...Hey... $$シン$$, are you in love with $$セツコ$$?」

425:t_10:26.en:
$$シン$$
「...It isn't that sort of love. I've always been grateful to $$セツコ$$.」

425:t_10:28.en:
$$シン$$
「When I was running simulations to fight your $$フリーダム$$ in my $$インパルス$$, $$キラ$$, $$セツコ$$ told me something.」

425:t_10:29.en:
$$シン$$
「She said, 'Don't fight out of hatred.'」

425:t_10:31.en:
$$シン$$
「In the end, I fought you out of hatred, $$キラ$$.」

425:t_10:32.en:
$$シン$$
「But even afterward, $$セツコ$$'s words kept ringing in my ears.」

425:t_10:33.en:
$$シン$$
「I still think I was able to return to $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ thanks to all of you and those words from $$セツコ$$.」

425:t_10:34.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So she's someone you owe a lot to.」

425:t_10:36.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「I understand, $$シン$$. I'm sorry I asked such a strange question.」

425:t_10:37.en:
$$シン$$
「I'm the one who should apologize... I made you worry about something strange, $$ルナ$$.」

425:t_10:38.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「It's all right. ...Let's give it our best, $$シン$$.」

425:t_10:40.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(The $$多元戦争$$ changed $$シン$$'s fate dramatically.)

425:t_10:41.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(That was due to his own strength and that of the people around him, but $$セツコ$$ played a part too.)

425:t_10:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Do your best, $$シン$$, everyone... I'm praying for $$セツコ$$'s safety too.)

425:t_10:43.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(I really don't feel up to facing everyone right now, so I'll congratulate our ace pilots another time...)

425:t_10:44.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
($$Ｄトレーダー$$ is operating as usual.)

425:t_10:45.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Today, I'll quietly get down to... business, business.)

426:t_000:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「We've confirmed the base facilities have self-destructed!」

426:t_000:1.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「We've also confirmed the remaining $$サイデリアル$$ troops have withdrawn!」

426:t_001:0.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We've successfully captured $$ターミナル・ベース$$, but it's strange that they destroyed it themselves.」

426:t_001:1.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Well, you don't see that much these days. It used to be common when they wanted to conceal information.」

426:t_001:2.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Perhaps there was something here worth going that far to protect.」

426:t_001:3.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, return to base. We'll send in ground personnel to investigate the facilities.」

426:t_001:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「They put up more resistance than I expected. It looks like forces really are gathering from all over.」
